content: Argo Rollouts: Kubernetes controller + CRDs for blue-green, canary, canary analysis, experimentation; integrates with ingress controllers/service meshes for traffic shaping and queries metric providers (e.g. Prometheus) via AnalysisTemplate to drive automated promotion or rollback. Flagger (fluxcd, CNCF) does the same (canary, A/B, blue/green mirroring) but is Flux-aligned and operates on existing Deployments rather than replacing them. For an Argo CD estate, Argo Rollouts is the coherent pick. ApplicationSet (bundled with Argo CD since v2.3) generates Applications from generators (list/git/cluster/matrix) - the modern replacement for hand-written app-of-apps child Applications, with documented security implications for multi-tenant use.
